searchText: There's (at least) one instance that renders the argument I laid above invalid: people that staked with custodial services may be tricked by such mechanisms out of all of their money There were other attempts to recover lost funds in a much more broad way, they all failed. I don't remember the EIP, or if I ever got enough support to create one, but I tried for a while to get the core devs to agree to recovering cases of lost/stuck/burnt funds via irregular state change when the losses were due to very obvous human error, like contract creation transactions with ETH attached and no calldata. Would you please create a new easy way to withdraw validators rewards without programing/coding skills required to accomplish all these hard tasks? I don't see how to accomplish this other than just a nice graphical interface with gui tips to explain the fields. Since you have to do this anyway offline to not expose the mnemonics, very little can be really changed IMO. I think the right place for this request is on hardware wallets support: once hardware wallets support BLS signatures and the such (probably they already do?) Then this can be made online My validator is not in any hardware wallet. There is many ways to guide users to accomplish all these hard tasks. A video showing how to execute all the steps could be a very good example. That's a good point but probably this already exists? The Ethstaker community had several calls with videos demonstrating how to withdraw, perhaps they recorded these? I'd ask in their discord server If you could provide the link to the video (if the video exist) it would be very nice! 😃 Oh I have no clue, haven't attended the calls, that's why I'm saying to ask in the Ethstaker server since they held the calls https://youtu.be/EMQoVtxNaxo Ok. I am asking about withdrawals in the Ethstakers server too. No solution at this moment. This is the first hit in YouTube, you can ask in Ethstaker or pinging <@102952036382830592> if he knows more <@755590043632140352> All right. I will watch the video to see if this video can help with how withdraw validators rewards. Thank you!
